answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a stake and earn endorsements through useful work observed over time. A public beacon records stakes and endorsement links, letting peers detect clusters funded or vouched for by the same source. A bridge can admit only identities whose stake survives a challenge period and whose work provides a credible signal. To mount a sybil attack, an attacker must tie up capital and build many convincing histories, making fake identities costly and slow to create.
